THE HARRISON C. WHITTAKER FAMILY REVOCABLE TRUST
As Amended and Restated November 4, 2025

Grantor and Initial Trustee: Eleanor Margaret Whittaker
Successor Trustees: Vivienne Whittaker Ashford, First Fairfield Trust Company, N.A.
Trust Situs: State of Connecticut

ARTICLE I — CREATION AND FUNDING
1.1 The Grantor, Eleanor Margaret Whittaker, hereby amends and restates the Harrison C. Whittaker Family Revocable Trust originally executed August 3, 2011.
1.2 Property Contributed. The trust is funded with the assets identified on Schedule A, including without limitation: (a) the residence at 47 Pine Cove Lane, Southport, CT 06890 (deeded to the trust September 12, 2011); (b) a securities account at Fidelity Investments (Account No. Z71-88412) with a value on October 31, 2025 of $4,182,000; (c) a limited partnership interest in Whittaker Coastal Holdings, L.P. representing a 22% limited partner interest; and (d) after-acquired property later assigned to the trust.

ARTICLE II — DISTRIBUTIONS DURING GRANTOR'S LIFETIME
2.1 During the Grantor's lifetime, the Trustee shall distribute to or for the benefit of the Grantor such amounts of income and principal as the Grantor may from time to time request in writing, or as the Trustee determines to be necessary or advisable for the Grantor's health, maintenance, and support in her accustomed standard of living.

ARTICLE III — INCAPACITY OF GRANTOR
3.1 If the Grantor is determined to be incapacitated (as certified in writing by two licensed physicians, at least one of whom is a board-certified neurologist or geriatric psychiatrist), the Successor Trustee shall assume administration. Currently designated physicians: Dr. Anders Kolbein and Dr. Priya Ramaswami.

ARTICLE IV — DISTRIBUTIONS AFTER GRANTOR'S DEATH
4.1 Upon the Grantor's death, the Trustee shall pay all just debts, funeral expenses, and taxes, then distribute the remaining trust estate as follows:
   (a) Family Residence. The residence at 47 Pine Cove Lane shall pass to Vivienne Whittaker Ashford outright, subject to a right of first refusal in favor of Margaux Whittaker Duplessis and Julian Preston Whittaker for a period of 120 days at appraised fair market value.
   (b) Marital Trust. Not applicable — Grantor's spouse predeceased her.
   (c) Descendants' Trust. The balance of the trust estate shall be divided into equal shares for each of the Grantor's then-living children, per stirpes, subject to Article V.

ARTICLE V — CHILDREN'S SEPARATE TRUSTS
5.1 The share allocated to each child shall be held in a separate trust for the benefit of that child and his or her descendants:
   (a) Vivienne's Trust: 40% of the balance;
   (b) Julian's Trust: 20% of the balance (reduced to reflect lifetime advances of approximately $675,000);
   (c) Margaux's Trust: 40% of the balance.
5.2 During the beneficiary's lifetime, the Trustee shall distribute income and principal for health, education, maintenance, and support ("HEMS" standard).
5.3 Upon the death of a beneficiary, the remaining trust shall pass per stirpes to the beneficiary's descendants, subject to the Rule Against Perpetuities as modified by Connecticut law (C.G.S. § 45a-491).

ARTICLE VI — POWERS OF TRUSTEE
The Trustee shall have all powers granted by Connecticut law and Chapter 802c of the Connecticut General Statutes, including the power to retain, sell, or exchange trust property; borrow; and delegate investment authority to a Registered Investment Adviser subject to prudent-investor standards.

ARTICLE VII — TAX PROVISIONS
7.1 GST Exemption. The Trustee is authorized to allocate the Grantor's remaining generation-skipping transfer tax exemption to the trusts created for grandchildren.
7.2 QTIP Elections. Not applicable.

ARTICLE VIII — SPENDTHRIFT PROVISION
No beneficiary shall have the power to transfer, assign, or encumber any interest in the trust, and no creditor of a beneficiary shall reach such interest, except as required by federal or Connecticut law.

ARTICLE IX — GOVERNING LAW
This trust shall be governed by Connecticut law.

Executed this 4th day of November, 2025 in Greenwich, Connecticut.

/s/ Eleanor Margaret Whittaker — Grantor and Initial Trustee

Notary: Alison T. Broussard, Notary Public, State of Connecticut, Commission Expires June 30, 2028
Preparing Attorney: Reginald M. Pothier, Esq., Pothier, Halligan & Wu LLP (Juris No. 428917)
